svg.aria-label: Your account stays safe: inside a box that stands for your PC sit the Kindle folder, your account keys in a locked box, Anzu and the Documents EPUB folder. The only thing that leaves the PC is a check sent to the official release of the unlock tool, which comes back verified; then a book goes from the Kindle folder through Anzu into the EPUB folder, and the keys never move.
svg.text: Online, it only checks the unlock tool.
